snippet.title: Arx - End Of Sun - Work In Progress - Demo Video 2
snippet.description:
The Arx End of Sun (Beta) is released! - See links below! and don't forget to install the patch release too!

We are proud to present to you after many months of hard work, our second work in progress video demonstration...

We have come a long way since our first WIP demo video... however there is still much to do before the demo release is ready...

Homepage: http://arxendofsun.solarsplace.com
Mod DB: http://www.moddb.com/mods/arx-end-of-sun/
Music: http://www.neuro-lab.net/
